about: The readiness verdict, case by case (docs/features/readiness.md). Walked by both implementations: watchlist-ready.test.ts (utils/watchlistReady) and tests/services/test_recommender_compute.py (recommender_compute.readiness). An item states only what differs from `defaults`; a case's franchise signals apply to every item, as the API sends them per entry.
